component.name: XSpaceWar-AI
component.summary: AI-driven networked space-fighter with real Newtonian physics

description.p: XSpaceWar-AI is a modern, AAA-styled networked space-fighter with a strong AI focus — a 2026 reimagining of the classic networked Spacewar! / xspacewar. Bird's-eye view like the 1962 original, but with space-accurate Newtonian physics, 100% procedurally generated graphics and audio, and LAN + internet multiplayer for up to 16 ships.

ul.li: Top-down arena dogfights around a gravity well, up to 16 ships.
Real Newtonian flight — conserved momentum, inverse-square gravity on ships and torpedoes, gravity-assist slingshots, hyperspace.
Procedurally generated everything — stars, planets, nebulae, ships, VFX, and audio; every match a fresh seeded arena.
Game modes: Free-for-all, Team battle, AI bots (Rookie to Insane), and an all-AI Movie Mode attract.

Multiplayer today: host-authoritative netcode with client-side prediction, automatic LAN discovery, direct IP, and internet play via room codes and an online server browser — no port forwarding required.
Seven UI languages: English, Spanish, French, Simplified Chinese, Arabic (RTL), and Hindi.
